```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "C:/Users/lon09/New folder")
```

```{r combined-analysis}
files <- list(
  "Question 1" = "Directq1_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Question 2" = "Directq2_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Question 3" = "Directq3_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Question 4" = "Directq4_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Question 5" = "Directq5_cosine_evaluation.csv",
  "Question 6" = "Directq6_cosine_evaluation.csv"
)

# Combine all 6 questions into one dataset
all_data <- data.frame()

for (question_name in names(files)) {
  df <- read.csv(files[[question_name]])
  df <- df[trimws(tolower(df$Run.time)) != "mean", ]
  colnames(df) <- c("Run", "NonChunking", "EqualChunking", "ManualChunkingOverlap", "LangChain", "LangChainOverlap")
  df[, -1] <- lapply(df[, -1], as.numeric)
  df$Question <- question_name
  all_data <- rbind(all_data, df)
}

# Reshape to long format
all_long <- pivot_longer(all_data, cols = c("NonChunking","EqualChunking","ManualChunkingOverlap","LangChain","LangChainOverlap"),
                         names_to = "Version", values_to = "Cosine")

all_long$Version <- factor(all_long$Version,
                           levels = c("NonChunking","EqualChunking","ManualChunkingOverlap","LangChain","LangChainOverlap"))

# Boxplot
ggplot(all_long, aes(x = Version, y = Cosine, fill = Version)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "red", outlier.shape = 16, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Cosine Similarity by Version - All Direct Questions",
       x = "Chunking Version", y = "Cosine Similarity Score")

# ANOVA
m <- aov(Cosine ~ Version, data = all_long)
summary(m)
```
